payload.rationale_summary: Watch negative reflects continued project execution delays across multiple sites, revenue decline of 14% in FY2024, rising leverage (Debt/Equity 2.75x), weakening cash flows, and subsidiary contract termination by NHAI. Bureau report shows SMA-1 status with Canara Bank. Elevated enquiry count (8 in 6 months) indicates funding stress.
key_rating_drivers: Longstanding infrastructure execution track record (20+ years)
Revenue decline of 14% in FY2024 due to project delays
High leverage: Debt/Equity at 2.75x, Debt/EBITDA at 5.10x
Subsidiary contract terminated by NHAI — contingent liability risk
SMA-1 status with 1 lender; elevated bureau enquiries

rating_sensitivity.upgrade: Resolution of NHAI dispute, revenue growth >10%, D/E <2.0x
rating_sensitivity.downgrade: Further delays, DPD escalation beyond SMA-1, or D/E >3.5x
